experiment.claim: Issue #22 -- NOT a spec claim (spec/target-spec.md does not exist yet, spec/porting-plan.md Sec4 item 4). Companion to sim/temp-core-startup/ (scenario A: EN tied high through the whole power-up ramp). This experiment exercises the EN axis temp_core has and bias_core does not (issue #22's own scope): VDD ramps from 0 V exactly as in sim/temp-core-startup/, but EN is held LOW until well after VDD has completed its ramp and settled, then released -- the DR-002 startup ordering temp_core will actually see once temp_por_top exists and drives EN from RESETn (which only deasserts after POR has already released, i.e. supply already up). Substantiates that temp_core's own startup kick still clears the degenerate zero-current branch when enabled LATE, at every point of the full 45-point PVT matrix, not just when EN was asserted for the whole ramp.
